# The conveyor: a plum rubber belt x -5.8..5.2, z -0.1..1.1, its top at y 0.85; teal side rails
# that stand 0.1 above it, four pairs of legs, a drum at each end; the intake hopper hangs over
# its left end from two rods (parcels drop out of it). Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Rubber --base-color 0.3961 0.2510 0.3255 --no-slot
material new Metal --base-color 0.2353 0.4196 0.3922 --no-slot
material new Drum --base-color 0.7137 0.8118 0.5569 --no-slot
material new Tin --base-color 0.2353 0.4196 0.3922 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.8196 0.6510 0.4941 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Belt --size 1 --location -0.300 -0.500 0.750
scale 11.000 1.200 0.200
apply --scale
material assign Rubber
active Belt
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9 && normal.y > -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name RailB --size 1 --location -0.300 0.170 0.775
scale 11.200 0.140 0.350
apply --scale
material assign Metal
active RailB
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name RailF --size 1 --location -0.300 -1.170 0.775
scale 11.200 0.140 0.350
apply --scale
material assign Metal
active RailF
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name LegB0 --size 1 --location -5.400 0.130 0.300
scale 0.140 0.140 0.600
apply --scale
material assign Metal
active LegB0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cube --name LegF0 --size 1 --location -5.400 -1.130 0.300
scale 0.140 0.140 0.600
apply --scale
material assign Metal
active LegF0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

scale 0.140 0.140 0.600

material assign Metal
active LegB1

select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"

apply --scale

active LegF1

scale 0.140 0.140 0.600
apply --scale
material assign Metal
active LegB3

select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"

mode object
add mesh cylinder --name DrumL --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 1.30 --location -5.80 -0.50 0.71 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Drum
add mesh cylinder --name DrumR --vertices 8 --radius 0.16 --depth 1.30 --location 5.20 -0.50 0.71 --rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Drum
add mesh cube --name Hopper --size 1 --location -5.000 -0.500 2.800
scale 1.100 1.100 1.100
apply --scale
material assign Tin
active Hopper
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces

scale 1.220 1.220 0.160

active HTrim

add mesh cube --name Rod0 --size 1 --location -5.350 -0.500 4.975
scale 0.100 0.100 3.250
apply --scale
material assign Metal
active Rod0

select face where "normal.y > 0.9 || normal.z < -0.9"

add mesh cube --name Rod1 --size 1 --location -4.650 -0.500 4.975

active Rod1
